name: Shuilingornis
sum: Gansuid euornithean from the Jiufotang Formation of China known from a nearly complete skeleton.
holotype: A nearly complete articulated skeleton on one slab with feather imprints around the hand (number in Wang et al. 2025).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Wang et al. 2025

sources.text: Wang, Xuri; Cau, Andrea; Wang, Yinuo; Kundrát, Martin; Zhang, Guili; Liu, Yichuan; Chiappe, Luis M. Febr. A new gansuid bird (Avialae, Euornithes) from the Lower Cretaceous (Aptian) Jiufotang Formation of Jianchang, western Liaoning, China. Cretaceous Research 166. doi:10.1016/j.cretres.2024.106014
